    target_uuid = bronze_candidates[0][0]
    bronze_mat = mgr.getMaterial(target_uuid)
    print(f"\nSetting Body ShapeMaterial to: {bronze_mat.Name}")
    body.ShapeMaterial = bronze_mat
elif metal_candidates:
    # Use first copper-like material
    target_uuid = metal_candidates[0][0]
    metal_mat = mgr.getMaterial(target_uuid)
    print(f"\nSetting Body ShapeMaterial to: {metal_mat.Name}")
    body.ShapeMaterial = metal_mat

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("\nDocument saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
print("Done!")
